1| package retain
2| 
3| import "time"
4| 
5| // sweepEvery is the pass cadence for the retention sweeper. Passes
6| // walk every tier; a pass that would overlap a still-running one is
7| // deferred rather than stacked, so a slow cold-tier volume cannot
8| // pile up concurrent sweeps.
9| const sweepEvery = 6 * time.Hour
10| 
11| // loop runs sweep passes on the fixed cadence until ctx ends.
12| func (s *Sweeper) loop() {
13| 	t := time.NewTicker(sweepEvery)
14| 	defer t.Stop()
15| 	for range t.C {
16| 		s.tryPass()
17| 	}
18| }
